transforms.code:
v = u'' if value is None else unicode(value)
	parts = v.split('|')
	st = parts[0][:1] if (parts and parts[0]) else ''
	prog = parts[2] if len(parts) >= 3 else '0'
	try:
		pid = int(float(prog))
	except:
		pid = 0
	if pid == 2:
		# Wait -- subtle muted nub (distinct from real progress)
		fill = u'rgba(100,116,139,0.55)'
		p = u'8'
	else:
		col = {'R':'request','H':'planned','P':'pending','K':'acknowledged','A':'approved','V':'active','C':'closed','D':'cancelled','F':'deferred'}
		fill = u'rgba(var(--wo-rgb-' + col[st] + u'),0.95)' if st in col else u'#196690'
		pct = {1:0, 3:25, 4:50, 5:75, 6:100}.get(pid, 0)
		p = unicode(pct)
	# v1.3.0: layer 1 = PO-linked dot, top-right, POList blue (#0B5ED7).
	# 4th pipe part HasPO ('1'/'0', optional - absent = no dot). Layer is
	# ALWAYS emitted (transparent when no PO) so the static two-entry
	# backgroundSize/Position/Repeat lists stay aligned per CSS layer rules.
	hasPO = False
	if len(parts) >= 4:
		try:
			hasPO = int(float(parts[3])) > 0
		except:
			hasPO = False
	dot = u'#0B5ED7' if hasPO else u'transparent'
	return (u'radial-gradient(circle, ' + dot + u' 55%, transparent 60%), '
		+ u'linear-gradient(to right, ' + fill + u' ' + p + u'%, transparent ' + p + u'%)')
